info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Human Resource Management Employee Data Management By Employee Data Management Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Employee Data Management Update API allows organizations in the banking sector to modify existing employee records efficiently. This endpoint facilitates updates to a range of employee data attributes identified by a unique Employee Data Management ID. Typical users of this API include HR teams and administrators who need to maintain accurate employee information in compliance with regulations. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure their employee data remains current and relevant, enhancing overall operational effectiveness.

patch.description: This endpoint allows the updating of specific employee data identified by the employee ID. Use this to modify any information related to the employee.

requestBody.description: Updates specific employee data associated with the employee ID. This operation allows modification of existing employee details. Ensure that only relevant fields are provided in the request.
